latestVersion.changelog: WebSocket streaming (~1s vs 30s cron polling); auto-reconnect with HTTP backlog drain on reconnect; long-running daemon replaces cron architecture (start.py spawns scripts/stream.py via setsid). State file shape: {cursor, pid, started_at}. Requires grupr>=0.3.0 SDK (PyPI).
